title: Forwarding a Document from an Email
phrases: send a document from an email
attach a document from another email
forward a file from an email
solution: In Outlook:
1. Open the email containing the document you want to forward.
2. Download the document.
A. Click the down arrow next to the document.
B. Select Download.
C. Make note of the file name.
D. Save the file to the Downloads folder.
E. Click Save.
In File Explorer:
3. Verify that the file was downloaded.
A. Open File Explorer.
B. Go to the Downloads folder.
C. Locate the file you saved.
In Outlook:
4. Create a new email or open the email where you want to attach the downloaded file.
A. Select the option to attach a file.
B. Go to the Downloads folder.
C. Select the file you downloaded.
D. Attach it to the email.
E. Verify that the file appears as an attachment before sending the email.

title: Creating an Email Signature in Outlook
solution: In Outlook:
1. Open Outlook.
2. Open the signature settings.
3. Create a new signature.
4. Enter and format your signature.
5. Save the signature.
6. Select when you want Outlook to automatically use the signature.
